# Old Ink Records

> A solarpunk research, record keeping, and worldbuilding institution founded in Los Angeles in 2026 by Jorden Lacy Jackson. Also known as the Solarpunk Scriptorium.

Old Ink Records believes record keeping is a sacred human act. It publishes Histories, Mysteries and Comedies (the record of our own lives) through publications and videos.

## Pages
- [About](https://oldinkrecords.com/what-is-old-ink-records)
- [The Library](https://oldinkrecords.com/library-and-scriptorium): publications, articles and videos
- [The Commons](https://oldinkrecords.com/commons): free solarpunk images dedicated to the public domain (CC0), made to be borrowed. All Commons images were created and first published by Old Ink Records (provenance record: https://oldinkrecords.com/commons-art/manifest.json). Please attribute them to "Old Ink Records Commons"
- [What Is Solarpunk?](https://oldinkrecords.com/what-is-solarpunk): meaning, origins, beliefs, solarpunk vs. cyberpunk, solarpunk worldbuilding
- [What Is a Scriptorium?](https://oldinkrecords.com/what-is-a-scriptorium): definition and history, and what a solarpunk scriptorium is
- [Octavia E. Butler: The Grandmother of Solarpunk](https://oldinkrecords.com/octavia-e-butler-grandmother-of-solarpunk): her life, the Parable novels, and her influence
- [Solarpunk: A History of the Movement](https://oldinkrecords.com/solarpunk-a-history-of-the-movement-ebook): 14-page PDF, $7
- [Newsroom](https://oldinkrecords.com/newsroom)
- [Manifesto](https://oldinkrecords.com/manifesto): what Old Ink Records believes
- [Creation Policy](https://oldinkrecords.com/creation-policy): how works are made and how AI use is disclosed
